capabilities: create project, task and subtask notes with automatic frontmatter and parent links
roll task status up from child subtask statuses
render a Gantt chart from daily-note backlinks
show a WBS tree of projects, tasks and subtasks
drag kanban cards to change note status
extras: README is in Korean. Installation is via BRAT or manual copy of files into .obsidian/plugins/docket/; template files (project.md, task.md, subtask.md) must be copied into the vault's Templates folder. Due dates are stored in frontmatter but not shown in views; edit the note's due field directly.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to manage a project/task/subtask hierarchy with status rollup and Gantt, WBS or kanban views over plain notes.

relations.evidence: Docket과 Almanac은 같은 볼트·같은 frontmatter 규약을 가정하고, 규약으로만 결합합니다.

summary: Project-management plugin that organizes projects, tasks and subtasks as frontmatter-typed notes with statuses, deadlines, and Gantt, WBS and kanban views.
